blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS
blocks.zh: 退化场景中的小说取景合成(NVS)旨在从受各种退化影响的多景观测中再现出3D场景,并生成清晰而光现实的画面取景于看不见的视点. 尽管最近取得了进展,但现有方法往往依赖针对退化的模式,限制了它们在不同极端环境中的概括。 基因模型提供了丰富的视觉前兆,但其输出往往会受像素错位和色彩偏差的影响,这可以被传播到被重建的3D场景并损害重建质量. 此外,3D重建的高计算和内存成本阻碍了NVS在极端环境中的实际应用. 为此,我们提出MLLM-GS,这是在极端环境中快速NVS的多式大型语言模型(MLM)的前导框架. MLLM-GS由两个分支组成:MLLM前导取景增强和快取3D场景重建. 前者利用被冷冻的MLLM丰富的视觉前科来增强不同严重降解下的观点,并引入了轻量级的校正网络来减少MLLM输出中像素相变和颜色扭曲. 在仅从少数对等的干净观点进行监督的情况下,这个分支会为所有退化的观测产生可靠的增强观点,为之后的3D重建提供伪GT观点. 后者通过优化光栅化,高斯内存布局,和参数更新来提高3DGS的效率,减少冗余计算,内存访问间接费用,并优化成本. 对多场退化场景的广泛实验表明,MLLM-GS能有效处理各种严重退化,并实现高质量的NVS,重建时间和记忆消耗明显降低. 项目网页:https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Novel view synthesis (NVS) ( Yu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2025b ) aims to model a 3D scene from existing multi-view observations and generate photorealistic images at unseen camera viewpoints.
It requires not only accurate scene geometry and appearance, but also spatial consistency and high visual quality across different views ( Bao et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .
By enabling 3D scene modeling and free-viewpoint rendering, NVS supports a wide range of applications, including virtual reality ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , digital twins ( Plizzari et al., 2024 ) , robotic perception ( Lei et al., 2025 ) , autonomous driving ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) , and digital content creation ( Dai et al., 2025 ) .
With the rapid advancement of immersive visual applications and 3D intelligence, NVS has become an important topic in computer vision and computer graphics ( Gao et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
小说取景合成(NVS)(Yu等,2026b;Liu等,2026b;Li等,2025b)旨在从已存在的多景观测中模拟出一出3D场景,并生成在未见相机视距上的相片现实化图像.
它不仅需要准确的场景几何和外观,还需要空间一致性和不同观点的高视觉质量(Bao等,2026;Guo等,2025.).
通过3D场景模型和自由取景点渲染,NVS支持了广泛的应用,包括虚拟现实(Yu等,2024年),数字双胞胎(Plizzari等,2024年),机器人感知(Lei等,2025年),自主驾驶(Zhou等,2026a),数字内容创作(Dai等,2025年)等.
随着浸入视觉应用和3D智能的迅速发展,NVS已经成为了计算机视觉和计算机图形学中的一个重要话题(高等等,2026b;于等,2026b.).

blocks.en:
Early NVS methods synthesize novel views by image interpolation ( Chen and Williams, 1993 ) , view reprojection ( Seitz and Dyer, 1996 ) , and explicit geometric reconstruction ( Debevec et al., 1996 ) .
Such pipelines often rely on accurate camera poses, cross-view correspondences, and scene geometry.
As a result, they can produce noticeable rendering errors under large viewpoint variations, complex occlusions, or inaccurate geometry estimation.
With the development of deep learning, researchers began to learn continuous scene representations with neural networks, reducing the dependence on explicit geometric reconstruction.
Among these approaches, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) implicitly models the mapping from spatial positions and viewing directions to color and density, and uses volume rendering to synthesize high-quality novel views.
NeRF significantly improves the representation capacity and rendering fidelity in complex scenes, and many follow-up methods ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2026c ; Levy et al., 2023 ; Cui et al., 2024b ) have been developed based on NeRF.
However, NeRF requires dense sampling along camera rays and a large number of network evaluations, resulting in long optimization times and making real-time rendering difficult.
blocks.zh:
早期NVS方法通过图像插值(Chen and Williams,1993年),视图再预测(Seitz and Dyer,1996年),和明确的几何重建(Debevec等,1996年)来合成出新颖的观点.
此类管线往往依赖于准确相机姿势,交叉取景通信,以及场景几何.
因此,它们可以在大视差、复杂的隐蔽或不准确的几何估计下产生明显的渲染错误。
随着深度学习的发展,研究人员开始用神经网络学习连续的场景表现,减少了对显式几何重建的依赖.
在这些方法中,神经辐射场(NERF)(Mildenhall等,2021年)隐含地模拟了从空间位置和取景方向到颜色和密度的绘图,并使用体积渲染来合成高质量的新观点.
NERF大大提高了在复杂场景中的表现能力和忠诚度,以及许多后续方法(Chen等,2023;Liu等,2026c; Levy等,2023; Cui等,2024b)是在NERF的基础上开发的.
然而,NERF需要用相机射线进行密集取样并进行大量的网络评价,从而导致长时间的优化时间并造成实时渲染困难.

blocks.en:
Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) has emerged as an important approach for NVS.
Unlike NeRF-based methods that represent a scene with implicit neural networks, 3DGS models scene geometry and appearance using a set of explicit 3D Gaussian primitives and directly projects them onto the image plane through differentiable rasterization.
Benefiting from its explicit scene representation and efficient splatting-based rendering, 3DGS significantly reduces optimization and rendering costs while maintaining high rendering quality.
Subsequent studies ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) have further improved 3DGS in terms of rendering quality, representation capability, and computational efficiency, establishing it as a practical paradigm for high-quality and efficient NVS.
blocks.zh:
最近,3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)(Kerbl等,2023年)作为NVS的重要方法出现.
与以NERF为基础的代表有隐性神经网络的场景的方法不同,3DGS模型的场景几何和外观使用一组明显的3D高斯原始,并通过可分光栅化直接将场景投射到图像平面上.
3DGS从其明显的场景表现和高效的以镀层为基础的渲染中受益,大大减少了优化和渲染成本,同时保持了高渲染质量.
随后的研究(Yang等,2025a;Hahlbohm等,2026;Ren等,2026;Lee等,2026)在制作质量,代表能力和计算效率方面进一步提高了3DGS,将它确立为高质量和高效NVS的实际范例.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, existing 3DGS-based methods still heavily rely on high-quality multi-view observations ( Li et al., 2025a ; Cui et al., 2025 ) .
In extreme environments involving smoke, low light, motion blur, and exposure variations, image structure, texture, and color information can be severely degraded.
Such degradations weaken the visual features required for accurate geometry estimation and appearance modeling, leading to structural errors, missing textures, and color distortions in reconstructed scenes.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , existing NVS methods ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) for degraded scenes mainly address these problems by introducing physical priors into the reconstruction process.
However, these methods typically rely on degradation-specific imaging models and assumptions.
As different degradations follow distinct imaging mechanisms, such assumptions may not hold under unknown or mixed degradation conditions, limiting their generalization in extreme environments.
Consequently, existing approaches struggle to achieve robust NVS across diverse extreme environments within a unified framework.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但基于3DGS的现有方法仍然严重依赖高质量的多视图观测 (Li等,2025a;Cui等,2025.).
在涉及烟雾、低光度、运动模糊和暴露变化、图像结构、纹理和颜色信息的极端环境中,可能会严重退化。
这种退化削弱了精确几何估计和外观模型化所需的视觉特征,导致结构出错,纹理缺失,并导致重建场景中的色彩扭曲.
如图1所示,现有的NVS方法(Lin等,2025;Liu等,2025a; Lee et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025b) 对于退化的场景,主要通过在重建过程中引入物理前身来解决这些问题.
然而,这些方法通常依赖于针对降解的成像模型和假设.
由于不同的降解遵循不同的成像机制,这些假设可能不会在未知或混合的降解条件下存在,限制了其在极端环境中的通化.
因此,现有的办法在统一的框架内,在各种极端环境中努力实现强有力的国家价值链。

blocks.en:
An intuitive solution is to restore degraded images before performing 3D reconstruction.
However, conventional image restoration networks ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Long et al., 2026 ) are typically trained on large-scale paired datasets and often specialize in particular degradation types.
Therefore, their performance can be limited by variations in degradation distributions or the lack of sufficient paired clean images.
This problem is particularly challenging in real-world extreme environments, where acquiring clean observations corresponding to all degraded viewpoints is often difficult.
Recent generative models ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) offer a promising alternative by leveraging rich visual priors learned from large-scale data to recover plausible scene structures and textures under diverse degradation conditions.
Nevertheless, their generation processes generally lack strict pixel-level constraints and may introduce spatial misalignment, altered textures, and color deviations.
Although the restored images may appear visually realistic, pixel misalignment and color deviations can make them inconsistent with the underlying scene geometry and appearance ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) .
When these images are used to supervise 3D reconstruction, such errors can propagate into the learned 3D representation, leading to structural distortions and appearance inconsistencies in novel-view renderings.
Therefore, effective NVS in extreme environments requires not only recovering visually plausible content but also improving the pixel-level fidelity of restored images under limited clean-image supervision.
blocks.zh:
一个直观的解决办法是在进行3D重建之前恢复已退化的图像.
然而,传统的图像恢复网络 (Yue等,2025;Wang等,2026a; Wu 等, 2026b; Long等, 2026) 通常接受大规模对等数据集的培训,并经常专门研究特定的降解类型.
因此,它们的性能可能受到降解分布变化或缺乏足够配对的清洁图像的限制.
在现实世界的极端环境中,这个问题尤其具有挑战性,因为在这种环境中,获得与所有已退化观点相适应的清洁观测往往十分困难。
最近的遗传模型(Wei等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2026年)提供了一个很有希望的替代办法,利用从大规模数据中汲取的丰富的视觉前科,在不同的退化条件下恢复可信的场景结构和纹理。
尽管如此,它们的生成过程一般缺乏严格的像素级限制,并可能引入空间错配,纹理被改变,以及颜色偏差.
虽然被恢复的图像可能出现视觉现实,但像素错位和颜色偏差会使其与基础场景几何和外观不一致(赵等,2026;杨等,2025b.).
当这些图像被用来监督3D重建时,这些错误会传播到所学到的3D代表中去,导致新视觉渲染中的结构扭曲和外观不一致.
因此,在极端环境中有效的NVS不仅需要恢复视觉上可信的内容,还需要在有限的清洁图像监督下改善恢复图像的像素水平的忠诚。

blocks.en:
Beyond reconstruction quality, computational efficiency remains another important challenge for NVS in severely degraded scenes.
Although view enhancement improves the quality of degraded observations, residual artifacts and cross-view inconsistencies can still disrupt Gaussian optimization and induce redundant densification ( Lyu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) .
The resulting increase in Gaussian primitives can further exacerbate the computational and memory overhead of standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) .
First, its conservative screen-space bounding regions include many pixels receiving negligible Gaussian contributions, resulting in unnecessary rasterization operations.
Second, its adaptive densification and pruning can scatter spatially neighboring Gaussians across memory, reducing memory-access efficiency.
Third, updating different Gaussian attributes through separate optimization operations introduces additional kernel launches and global memory accesses.
Although recent acceleration methods ( Ren et al., 2026 ; Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ; Hanson et al., 2025a ) have improved 3DGS efficiency, these strategies have mainly been developed and evaluated using high-quality observations.
Their effectiveness in degraded scenes remains insufficiently explored.
Therefore, achieving both high-quality reconstruction and low computational cost under diverse severe degradations remains challenging.
blocks.zh:
除了重建质量外,计算效率仍然是NVS在严重退化场景中面临的另一个重大挑战.
虽然取景增强能提高退化观测的质量,但残留的文物和交叉视图的不一致仍能扰乱高斯优化,并诱发冗余密度(Lyu等,2026;周等,2026b.).
由此而来的高斯原始语的增加会进一步加剧标准3DGS的计算和内存间接费用(Kerbl等,2023年).
首先,其保守的屏幕-空间界限区域包括许多接受可忽略不计的高斯贡献的像素,导致不必要的光栅化操作.
其次,其适应性密度和穿透性可以分散空间相邻的高斯人跨越记忆,降低内存访问效率.
第三,通过单独的优化操作来更新不同的高斯属性,引入了额外的内核发射和全球内存访问.
虽然最近的加速方法(Ren等,2026;Hahlbohm等,2026;Hanson等,2025a)提高了3DGS的效率,但这些策略主要是利用高品质的观测结果来制定和评估的.
在退化的场景中,尚未充分探讨其有效性。
因此,在各种严重退化的情况下实现高质量重建和低计算成本仍然是一项挑战。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments.
MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction.
The former leverages the visual priors of MLLMs to generate reliable pseudo-GT views from degraded observations, thereby alleviating the scarcity of reliable supervision for 3D reconstruction.
Specifically, we employ a frozen MLLM to generate corresponding enhanced views from degraded observations under diverse degradation conditions.
In this way, the framework exploits the rich visual priors of the MLLM to handle multiple degradations in a unified manner, avoiding the need for degradation-specific restoration models.
Indeed, a similar prior-based enhancement strategy was also validated in the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction Challenge ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , where our Smoke-GS ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) solution achieved second place in Track 2.
However, the MLLM generation process lacks strict pixel-level constraints and may introduce pixel shifts and color distortions.
To address this issue, we further design a lightweight correction network.
The network refines the MLLM-enhanced results in a color space that decouples luminance and chrominance, enabling more effective correction of pixel misalignment and color distortions.
By leveraging the pretrained visual priors of a frozen MLLM and training only the lightweight correction network, the view enhancement branch can be effectively optimized using a few paired clean views.
In this way, the view enhancement branch reduces structural and color distortions in the restored images, providing more reliable pseudo-GT supervision for subsequent 3DGS optimization.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出MLLM-GS,这是一个在极端环境中快速NVS的多式大语言模型(MLM)前导框架.
MLLM-GS由两个分支组成:MLLM前导取景增强和快取3D场景重建.
前者利用MLLMs的视觉前科,从退化的观测中生成可靠的伪GT视图,从而缓解了3D重建的可靠监管的稀缺性.
具体地说,我们使用一种被冻结的MLLM来从不同退化条件下的退化观测中得出相应的强化观点.
这样,框架就利用了MLLM丰富的视觉前科,以统一的方式处理多重降解,避免了需要针对降解的修复模型.
事实上,在NTIRE 2026 3D恢复和重建挑战(Liu等,2026a)中也验证了类似的先前的增强战略,在该案中,我们的Smoke-GS(Zheng等,2026年)解决方案在第2轨取得了第二名.
然而,MLLM生成过程缺乏严格的像素级约束,可能引入像素变换和色彩扭曲.
为了解决这一问题,我们进一步设计了轻量级矫正网络。
网络精炼了MLLM-增强后产生的色相空间能分解出发光和色相,使像素错配和色相扭曲得到更有效的纠正.
通过利用被冻结的MLLM的预训视觉前科,并只培训轻量级的校正网络,可以使用几对干净的视图来有效优化视图增强分支.
这样一来,取景增强分支减少了被恢复图像中的结构和颜色扭曲,为之后的3DGS优化提供了更可靠的伪GT监督.

blocks.en:
After obtaining reliable pseudo-GT views, we further focus on reducing the computational and memory overhead of 3DGS during scene reconstruction.
To this end, we design a fast 3D scene reconstruction branch and accelerate the optimization process from three aspects: rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates.
Specifically, we adopt opacity-aware axis-aligned rectangular bounding boxes to reduce unnecessary rasterization computations.
We reorder active Gaussians using Morton codes to improve memory-access efficiency for spatially adjacent Gaussians, and fuse the Adam updates of different parameter groups into a single CUDA kernel to reduce kernel launches and global memory access.
With these designs, MLLM-GS significantly improves the optimization efficiency of 3DGS while maintaining high reconstruction quality.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLLM-GS consistently achieves high-quality NVS under diverse degradations.
Compared with baselines trained for 30K iterations, MLLM-GS achieves superior reconstruction quality with only 5K iterations, reducing training time by approximately 9× while consuming substantially less GPU memory.
blocks.zh:
在获取了可靠的伪GT视图后,我们进一步专注于在场景重建期间降低3DGS的计算和内存管理费.
为此,我们设计了快取3D场景重建分支,从光栅化,内存布局,参数更新三个方面加快了优化进程.
具体来说,我们采用不透明-有意识轴相接矩形接框来减少不必要的光栅化计算.
我们用莫顿代码对活跃的高斯人进行重排,以提高相邻空间的高斯人内存访问效率,并将不同参数组的亚当更新整合为单一的CUDA内核来减少内核发射和全球内存访问.
通过这些设计,MLLM-GS在保持高重建质量的同时,大大提高了3DGS的优化效率.
广泛的实验表明,在多种降解下,MLLM-GS一直能实现高质量的NVS.
与30K迭代训练的基线相比,MLLM-GS的重建质量更高,只有5K迭代,将培训时间缩短了大约9xx,同时消耗的GPU内存要少得多.

blocks.en:
Our main contributions can be summarized as: • We propose MLLM-GS, a unified framework for fast NVS in extreme environments.
It combines MLLM prior-guided view enhancement with fast 3D reconstruction to enable high-quality NVS across diverse severe degradations using only a few paired clean views. • We develop an MLLM prior-guided view enhancement branch that leverages the visual priors of a frozen MLLM to restore degraded views.
A lightweight correction network reduces residual structural and color errors under few-shot supervision, providing reliable pseudo-GT views for 3D reconstruction. • We design a fast 3D scene reconstruction branch that improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates, enabling faster scene reconstruction in degraded scenes. • We conduct extensive experiments across multiple severe degradation scenarios, including smoke, low light, motion blur, and exposure variations.
Experimental results demonstrate that MLLM-GS achieves high-quality NVS while substantially reducing reconstruction time and GPU memory consumption compared with representative methods.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献可以概括为:我们提议在极端环境中建立快速国家价值链的统一框架MLLM-GS。
它将MLLM前导取景增强与快速的3D重建相结合,使得高品质的NVS能够跨越不同的严重退化,只使用几对干净的取景. ^ . 我们开发了一个MLLM前导视图增强分支,利用被冷冻的MLLM的视觉前传来恢复已退化的视图.
轻量级的校正网络在几发的监督下会减少残余的结构和颜色错误,为3D重建提供可靠的伪GT视图. ^ 我们设计了快速3D场景重建分支,通过优化光栅化,内存布局,和参数更新来提高3DGS的效率,使得退化场景的场景重建更快. ^ 我们针对多种严重的退化情景进行了广泛的实验,包括烟雾、低光、运动模糊和暴露变化。
实验结果表明,与代表性方法相比,MLLM-GS实现了高质量的NVS,同时大幅减少了重建时间和GPU内存消耗.

blocks.en:
We propose MLLM-GS, a unified framework for fast NVS in extreme environments.
It combines MLLM prior-guided view enhancement with fast 3D reconstruction to enable high-quality NVS across diverse severe degradations using only a few paired clean views.
blocks.zh:
我们提出MLLM-GS,一个在极端环境中快速NVS的统一框架.
它将MLLM前导取景增强和快取3D重建相结合,使得高品质的NVS能够跨越不同的严重退化,只使用少数对接的清洁取景.

blocks.en:
We develop an MLLM prior-guided view enhancement branch that leverages the visual priors of a frozen MLLM to restore degraded views.
A lightweight correction network reduces residual structural and color errors under few-shot supervision, providing reliable pseudo-GT views for 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
我们开发了一个MLLM前导视图增强分支,利用被冻结的MLLM的视觉前兆来恢复已退化的视图.
一个轻量级的校正网络在几发的监督下会减少残余的结构和颜色错误,为3D重建提供可靠的伪GT视图.

blocks.en: We design a fast 3D scene reconstruction branch that improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates, enabling faster scene reconstruction in degraded scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个快速的3D场景重建分支,通过优化光栅化,内存布局,和参数更新来提高3DGS的效率,使得退化场景的场景重建更快.

blocks.en:
We conduct extensive experiments across multiple severe degradation scenarios, including smoke, low light, motion blur, and exposure variations.
Experimental results demonstrate that MLLM-GS achieves high-quality NVS while substantially reducing reconstruction time and GPU memory consumption compared with representative methods.
blocks.zh:
我们针对多种严重的退化情景进行了广泛的实验,包括烟雾、低光、运动模糊和暴露变化。
实验结果表明,与代表性方法相比,MLLM-GS实现了高质量的NVS,同时大幅减少了重建时间和GPU内存消耗.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 NVS in Degraded Scenes
blocks.zh: 2.1 NVS在有辱人格的情况下

blocks.en:
3DGS ( Fei et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Sabour et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) has become an effective representation for 3D reconstruction and NVS, achieving high-quality rendering with relatively low computational cost.
However, standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) relies on reliable multi-view observations, and its performance can degrade substantially under severe imaging conditions, such as smoke, low light, and motion blur ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Guo et al., 2026 ) .
To address this limitation, recent studies ( Yoon and Yoon, 2026 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Yan et al., 2026 ) have introduced physical priors into 3DGS to improve reconstruction from degraded observations.
For example, DehazeGS ( Yu et al., 2026a ) integrated an atmospheric scattering model into Gaussian primitives, and jointly estimated transmission and atmospheric light to recover clear scene appearances from hazy images.
RestorGS ( Qiao et al., 2025 ) decoupled scene appearance from degradation effects and introduced depth-guided self-supervision to improve reconstruction quality.
WaterSplatting ( Li et al., 2025a ) extended Gaussian representations with a volumetric medium field to model underwater backscattering effects.
blocks.zh:
3DGS(Fei等,2025;Ren等,2026;Zhang等,2024;Sabour等,2025;Wang等,2025;Lee等,2026;Chen等,2025;Song等,2025;Wang等,2026c)成为了3D重建和NVS的有效代表,实现了高品质渲染,计算成本相对较低.
然而,标准3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)依赖于可靠的多视图观测,其性能可以在烟雾,低光等严重成像条件下大量降解,运动模糊(Liu等,2026a; 郭等, 2026 (中文(简体) ).
为解决这一局限性,近期的研究(Yoon和Yoon,2026;Lin等,2025;Liu等,2025a;Lee等,2024;Yu等,2026b;Liu等,2025b;Yan等,2026)将物理前科引入了3DGS,以改善从已退化的观测中重建.
例如,DehazeGS(Yu等,2026a)将大气散射模型集成到高斯原始物中,并联合估计了传播和大气光,以从模糊图像中恢复清晰的场景外观.
RestorGS(Qiao等,2025年)将场景外观与退化效应脱钩,并引入了深度制导自监控,以提高重建质量.
WaterSplating (Li等, 2025a.)将高斯代表作以量子中场扩展为模型来模拟水下回流效应.

blocks.en:
Although these methods improve reconstruction under specific degradation conditions, they typically rely on degradation-specific imaging models and assumptions.
Since different degradations arise from distinct imaging mechanisms, these assumptions may not hold under unknown or mixed degradations, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments.
In contrast, our method leverages the general visual priors of a pretrained MLLM to enhance observations under different degradation conditions without requiring degradation-specific imaging models, thereby providing more reliable supervision for subsequent 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些方法改善了在特定退化条件下的重建,但它们通常依赖于与退化有关的成像模型和假设。
由于不同的成像机制产生不同的降解,这些假设可能不会在未知的或混合的降解下存在,从而限制了其在各种极端环境中的通俗化。
相比之下,我们的方法利用预先训练的MLLM的一般视觉前兆,加强不同退化条件下的观测,而不需要针对退化的成像模型,从而为随后的3D重建提供更可靠的监督.

blocks.en: 2.2 Generative Priors for Restoration and Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 恢复和重建的转基因历程

blocks.en:
Recent advances in generative modeling ( Conde et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Yılmaz et al., 2026 ; Fei et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) have opened new opportunities for image restoration. Unlike conventional restoration networks ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025c ) that often specialize in specific degradation types, generative models leverage rich visual priors to handle diverse degradations.
InstructIR ( Conde et al., 2024 ) introduced instruction-conditioned restoration for multiple degradation tasks.
DiffBIR ( Lin et al., 2024 ) employed diffusion priors to recover realistic image details, while Edit2Restore ( Yılmaz et al., 2026 ) explored adapting image editing models to restoration tasks.
blocks.zh:
遗传模型的最近进展(Conde等,2024;Lin等,2024;Yılmaz等,2026;Fei等,2026;Gu等,2026;Wu等,2026a; Tang等, 2026; Wang等, 2026b.)为图像修复开辟了新的机遇. 与常规修复网络(张等,2025;高等等,2026a;江等,2025;张等,2026;龚等,2025;崔等,2026;李等,2025c)不同,这些网络往往专门研究特定的降解类型,基因模型利用丰富的视觉前科来处理多种降解.
指令IR(Conde等,2024年)为多重降解任务引入了有指导条件的修复.
DiffBIR(Lin等,2024年)采用扩散前科来恢复现实的图像细节,而Edit2Restore(Yılmaz等,2026年)则探索将图像编辑模型适应恢复任务.

blocks.en:
Recent studies ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) further demonstrated the potential of general generative models for image restoration across diverse degradations.
Such restoration strategies have also been explored for 3D reconstruction.
For example, Smoke-GS ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) leveraged generative visual priors to enhance degraded observations for subsequent reconstruction.
GenSmoke-GS ( Cao et al., 2026 ) and Dehaze-then-Splat ( Chen and Wang, 2026a ) investigated restoration-assisted reconstruction in smoky scenes, while NAKA-GS ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) addressed reconstruction under low-light conditions.
However, generative restoration models may introduce pixel misalignment and color deviations ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , which can propagate into 3D reconstruction and compromise geometry and appearance consistency ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026d ) .
To address this limitation, our method combines the visual priors of a frozen MLLM with a lightweight correction network trained using only a few paired clean views, providing more reliable pseudo-GT supervision for 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究(Wei等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2026年)进一步证明了一般基因模型在各种降解中恢复图像的潜力。
还为3D重建探索了这种恢复战略。
例如,Smoke-GS(Zheng等,2026年)利用基因视觉前科,为以后的重建加强退化观测。
一般事务 (Cao等,2026年)和德哈泽-当时-斯派克(Chen和Wang,2026a)调查了烟雾场景中的恢复援助重建,而NAKA-GS(Zhu等,2026年)则在低光条件下处理重建问题.
然而,基因还原模型可能引入像素错配和颜色偏差(Sun等,2026;Zhao等,2026),可以传播到3D重建中并损害几何和外观一致性(Liu等,2026a; 王等, 2026d. (中文(简体) ).
为了解决这一局限性,我们的方法将被冻结的MLLM的视觉前科与只使用几对干净视图训练的轻量级修正网络结合起来,为3D重建提供了更可靠的伪GT监督.

blocks.en: 2.3 Efficient 3DGS
blocks.zh: 2.3 高效3DGS

blocks.en:
Although 3DGS enables efficient rendering, its adaptive density control can introduce a large number of Gaussian primitives, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead.
To improve efficiency, existing studies ( Chen and Wang, 2026b ; Jiao et al., 2026 ; Ren et al., 2026 ; Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) have explored reducing redundant Gaussian growth, accelerating rasterization, and optimizing the training process.
For instance, Mini-Splatting ( Fang and Wang, 2024 ) introduced spatially aware densification and Gaussian simplification to concentrate primitives in informative regions.
Taming 3DGS ( Mallick et al., 2024 ) combined gradient information with auxiliary signals to guide Gaussian growth and reduce redundant densification.
LightGaussian ( Fan et al., 2024 ) reduced the number of primitives through opacity- and volume-based pruning, while PUP-3DGS ( Hanson et al., 2025b ) employed sensitivity scores to identify and remove redundant components from pretrained representations.
Beyond Gaussian reduction, Speedy-Splat ( Hanson et al., 2025a ) improved rasterization efficiency by tightening Gaussian tile coverage to avoid unnecessary computations.
Faster-GS ( Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) further accelerated 3DGS optimization through efficient backward propagation, locality-preserving Gaussian reordering, and fused parameter updates.
Other studies ( Lan et al., 2025 ; Pehlivan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) further explored efficient optimization and GPU implementations to reduce the computational cost of 3DGS.
blocks.zh:
尽管3DGS能够使渲染效率得到提高,但其适应性密度控制可以引入大量高斯原始人,从而产生大量的计算和内存上浮.
为了提高效率,现有的研究(陈和王,2026b;焦等,2026;任等,2026;Hahlbohm等,2026)已探索减少冗余高斯生长,加快光栅化,优化培训过程.
例如,Mini-Splating(Fang and Wang, 2024)在空间上引入了感知密度和高斯简化,将原始人集中到信息区。
Taming 3DGS(Mallick等,2024年)将梯度信息与辅助信号相结合来引导高斯生长并减少冗余密度.
轻而易举 (Fan等,2024年)通过不透明与量基回放来减少原始人的数量,而PUP-3DGS(Hanson等,2025年b)则采用灵敏分数来识别并去除被事先训练过的表示中多余的成分.
除了高斯还原,"快活-斯普拉特"(Hanson等,2025年a)通过收紧高斯瓦覆盖,避免不必要的计算,提高了光栅化效率.
更快的GS(Hahlbohm等,2026年)通过高效的后向传播,局部保留高斯再排序,并被引信参数更新,进一步加速了3DGS优化.
其他研究(Lan等,2025;Pehlivan等,2026;Ye等,2025)进一步探索了高效优化和GPU的实施,以降低3DGS的计算成本.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, existing acceleration methods have primarily been developed and evaluated using high-quality observations.
In degraded scenes, residual artifacts and cross-view inconsistencies may persist even after view enhancement, potentially disrupting Gaussian optimization and inducing redundant densification.
This can further increase rasterization costs and memory-access overhead during reconstruction.
However, the effectiveness of existing acceleration strategies under such conditions remains insufficiently explored.
To address this challenge, we investigate efficient 3DGS optimization in degraded scenes by optimizing rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates to reduce redundant computation and memory-access overhead.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的加速方法主要是利用高质量的观测结果来制定和评估的。
在已退化的场景中,残余的文物和交叉视图的不一致即使在增强视野后也可能持续存在,可能干扰高斯优化并诱发冗余的密度.
这可以进一步增加光栅化成本和重建期间的内存存取间接费用.
然而,在这种条件下现有加速战略的有效性仍未得到充分探讨。
为了应对这一挑战,我们通过优化光栅化、内存布局和参数更新,在退化的场景中调查高效的3DGS优化,以减少冗余计算和内存访问费用。

Figure 2: Overall pipeline of the proposed MLLM-GS framework .
It consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction.
The former combines a frozen MLLM with a lightweight correction network trained using a few paired clean views to generate reliable pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction.
The latter accelerates 3DGS optimization through efficient rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates, enabling fast and high-quality NVS.

后者通过高效的光栅化,内存布局,和参数更新来加速3DGS优化,使能快速而高质量的NVS.

To achieve this goal, we propose MLLM-GS, a framework for fast NVS in extreme environments.

后者利用这些伪GT视图来重建3D场景,并在光栅化,内存布局,参数更新等方面提高3DGS优化效率.
MLLM-GS通过将可靠的取景增强与高效的立体重建相结合,使各种严重退化的NVS能够高质量和快速地进行.

blocks.en: 3.2 MLLM Prior-Guided View Enhancement
blocks.zh: 3.2 MLLM 前导视图增强

blocks.en:
Images captured in extreme environments often suffer from severe degradations, including smoke, low light, defocus blur, motion blur, and exposure variation.
These degradations can damage both structural and color information.
Directly using degraded views to supervise 3D reconstruction can introduce errors in both scene geometry and appearance, leading to suboptimal NVS results.
An intuitive solution is to restore the views before reconstruction.
However, existing restoration networks ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) typically require extensive paired training data and are often specialized for specific degradation types, limiting their applicability under diverse degradations.
To address these limitations, we develop an MLLM prior-guided view enhancement branch that combines a frozen MLLM with a lightweight correction network.
The MLLM leverages general visual priors to enhance observations under diverse degradations, while the correction network reduces residual structural and color distortions using only a few paired clean views.
In this way, the branch extends limited clean supervision to all input views, providing reliable pseudo-GT images for subsequent 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
在极端环境中捕捉到的图像往往会严重退化,包括烟雾、低光、去焦模糊、运动模糊和暴露变化等。
这些退化既会破坏结构信息,也会破坏色彩信息.
直接利用已退化的视图来监督3D重建,可以同时引入场景几何和外观上的错误,导致NVS结果不理想.
一个直观的解决办法是在重建前恢复观点.
然而,现有的恢复网络(Zhang等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年)通常需要广泛的对接培训数据,并且往往专门处理具体的退化类型,限制了它们在多种退化情况下的适用性。
为解决这些局限性,我们开发了一个MLLM前导取景增强分支,将被冷冻的MLLM与轻量级校正网络结合.
MLLM利用一般的视觉前兆来增强在多样降解下进行的观测,而校正网络则仅使用几对干净的视图来减少残留的结构和颜色扭曲.
这样,分支将有限的清洁监督扩展到了所有输入视图,为之后的3D重建提供了可靠的伪GT图像.

blocks.en:
Although e i \textbf{\emph{e}}_{i} recovers plausible scene structures and textures, it may still contain residual structural and color distortions.
To reduce these errors, we further process e i \textbf{\emph{e}}_{i} using the correction network illustrated in Fig. 2 .
The correction network first converts e i \textbf{\emph{e}}_{i} into the Horizontal/Vertical-Intensity (HVI) color space ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 3.3 Fast 3D Scene Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.3 快速三维场景重建

blocks.en:
After view enhancement, the corrected views serve as pseudo-GT supervision for 3D scene reconstruction.
However, residual artifacts and cross-view inconsistencies may still affect Gaussian optimization and induce redundant densification, increasing the computational and memory overhead of 3DGS.
First, the conservative screen-space bounding boxes used in standard 3DGS include regions with negligible Gaussian contributions, resulting in unnecessary rasterization operations.
Second, adaptive densification and pruning can scatter spatially neighboring Gaussians across memory, reducing memory-access efficiency.
Third, updating different Gaussian attributes through separate optimization kernels introduces additional kernel launches and global memory accesses.
Inspired by Faster-GS ( Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) , we develop a fast 3D scene reconstruction branch that accelerates 3DGS optimization from three aspects: rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates.

第二,适应性密度和穿透性可以将相邻的高斯人分散到内存上,降低内存存取效率.
第三,通过独立的优化内核来更新不同的高斯属性,引入了额外的内核发射和全球内存访问.
受"快活-GS"(Hahlbohm等,2026年)的启发,我们发展出从光栅化,内存布局,参数更新三个方面来加速3DGS优化的快活3D场景重建分支.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Rasterization

Standard 3DGS assigns a conservative square bounding box to each projected Gaussian, with its half-extent determined by the larger eigenvalue of the projected 2D covariance matrix.
However, this bounding box can substantially overestimate the effective screen-space coverage, especially for anisotropic Gaussians.
In degraded scenes, residual artifacts and cross-view inconsistencies in the enhanced views may induce redundant Gaussian densification, further increasing rasterization overhead.
To reduce unnecessary computation, we adopt opacity-aware, axis-aligned rectangular bounding boxes that estimate the effective Gaussian extent along each screen axis separately.

然而,这个边框可以大大地高估有效的屏幕-空间覆盖,特别是对异同位素高斯人而言.
在退化的场景中,剩余文物和增强视野中的交叉视图不一致可能会诱发多余的高斯密度化,使光栅化水平进一步上升.
为了减少不必要的计算,我们采用不透明感知,轴相通的矩形边框,分别估计每个屏幕轴上的有效高斯度.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Memory Layout
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 内存布局

blocks.en:
The adaptive density-control mechanism in 3DGS periodically clones, splits, and prunes Gaussian primitives.
Newly generated Gaussians are typically appended to parameter buffers, causing spatially neighboring Gaussians to become scattered across memory as optimization proceeds.
Consequently, processing nearby Gaussians may require accessing distant memory locations, reducing cache efficiency and increasing memory-access overhead.
To improve memory locality, we periodically reorder Gaussian primitives using Morton encoding, which maps three-dimensional positions into a one-dimensional Z-order sequence.
blocks.zh:
3DGS中的适应性密度控制机制定期克隆,分化,和普鲁士高斯原始.
新生成 高斯人一般被附加在参数缓冲上,使空间相邻的高斯人随着优化的进行而变得分散于内存中.
因此,附近处理 高斯人可能需要访问远程内存位置,降低缓存效率并增加内存访问的间接费用.
为了改进内存位置,我们定期用莫顿编码重新排列高斯原始人,将三维位置映射为一维Z序列.

For each Gaussian mean 𝝁 = ( x , y , z ) \bm{\mu}=(x,y,z) , we compute a Morton code as W ⁡ ( 𝝁 ) = OR k = 0 2 ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( ⌊ 1023 ⋅ μ k − min k max k − min k ⌋ ) ≪ k ) , W(\bm{\mu})=\operatorname{OR}_{k=0}^{2}\left(\phi\left(\left\lfloor 1023\cdot\frac{\mu_{k}-\text{min}_{k}}{\text{max}_{k}-\text{min}_{k}}\right\rfloor\right)\ll k\right), (8) where OR k = 0 2 \operatorname{OR}_{k=0}^{2} denotes the bitwise OR operation, and ϕ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \phi(\cdot) represents bit expansion for Morton encoding, and ≪ \ll denotes the bitwise left-shift operation.
Each coordinate is normalized according to the scene bounds and quantized into a 10-bit integer.
The bits of the three coordinates are then interleaved to generate a Morton code.

Morton encoding approximately preserves spatial locality by assigning nearby 3D positions to nearby locations in the one-dimensional ordering.
We apply radix sorting to the Morton codes and reorder the corresponding Gaussian parameter tensors according to the sorted indices.
This organization improves the spatial locality of Gaussian memory accesses, allowing neighboring threads to access more contiguous memory regions during optimization.
To limit the additional sorting cost, reordering is performed only at densification intervals rather than at every training iteration.

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Parameter Updates
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 参数更新

blocks.en:
Standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) optimizes Gaussian attributes, including position, rotation, scale, opacity, and spherical harmonic coefficients, using Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) .
These attributes are organized into separate parameter groups, and their updates typically involve multiple kernel launches and global-memory accesses.
Each update requires reading gradients, optimizer states, and parameter values from memory and writing the updated results back.
As the number of Gaussian primitives increases, these operations introduce considerable computational and memory-bandwidth overhead.
Inspired by Faster-GS ( Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) , we fuse the Adam updates of different parameter groups into a single CUDA kernel and use contiguous buffers for unified parameter updates, reducing the overhead.

这些属性被组织成单独的参数组,其更新通常涉及多个内核发射和全球-元辅.
每次更新都需要读取梯度,优化器状态,以及来自内存的参数值并回写更新后的结果.
随着高斯原始人数量的增加,这些操作引入了相当多的计算和内存带宽的起落架.
受"快活-GS"(Hahlbohm等,2026年)的启发,将不同参数组的亚当更新整合为单一的CUDA内核,并使用相接缓冲来进行统一的参数更新,减少了上下架.

blocks.en:
Specifically, we fuse the Adam updates of different Gaussian parameter groups into a single CUDA kernel and organize the corresponding parameters and optimizer states in contiguous memory buffers.
Each thread loads the parameter value, gradient, and moment estimates into registers, where the Adam moment updates, bias correction, and parameter update are performed using fused arithmetic operations.
The updated parameters and optimizer states are then written back to global memory.
By reducing kernel launches and redundant global-memory accesses, this strategy improves the efficiency of Gaussian parameter updates, particularly when optimizing a large number of Gaussian primitives.

每个线程将参数值,梯度,和瞬时估计值加载到登记册中,其中亚当瞬时更新,偏差校正,和参数更新都使用已引信算术操作进行.

Implementation Details: For the MLLM prior-guided view enhancement branch, we use Nano Banana Pro ( Raisinghani, 2025 ) as the default frozen MLLM.
For the correction network, the MLLM-enhanced images are first converted into HVI color space using a learnable density parameter initialized to 0.2 0.2 .
The correction network then refines the HVI representations, which are converted back to RGB space to obtain the corrected images.
We adopt the AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) optimizer with an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , coupled with a cosine annealing schedule ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2016 ) for dynamic learning rate adjustment, and train on randomly cropped 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches.
The correction network is trained using only the first three pairs of degraded and corresponding clean images from each scene.

Benchmarks: We evaluate MLLM-GS on the RealX3D benchmark ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , which provides real-world multi-view observations captured under challenging imaging conditions, including smoke, low light, and exposure variations.
RealX3D provides degraded observations and their corresponding clean reference images, enabling quantitative evaluation of NVS quality under challenging imaging conditions.
For each scene, the training and test views are disjoint.
During training, only three paired degraded and clean views are used to supervise the correction network.
The resulting enhancement branch generates pseudo-GT images for all training views, while the clean reference images at test viewpoints are used exclusively for evaluation.
Fig. 3 presents the numbers of training and test views for the smoke and low-light scenes.

基准: 我们在RealX3D基准(Liu等人,2026年b)上评价MLLM-GS,该基准提供在有挑战性的成像条件下(包括烟雾、低光和暴露变异)获取的现实世界多景观测。
RealX3D提供已退化的观测及其相应的清洁参考图像,从而能够在有挑战性的成像条件下对NVS质量进行定量评价.
对每个场景来说,训练和测试观点是脱节的.
在培训期间,仅使用3对退化和清洁的视图来监督矫正网络。
由此产生的增强分支会为所有培训视图生成伪GT图像,而测试角度的清洁参考图像则专门用于评价.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Metrics: To evaluate rendering quality, we report Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) for quantitative evaluation.
Specifically, PSNR measures pixel-level reconstruction fidelity, while SSIM evaluates structural similarity between the rendered and reference images.
Higher values ( ↑ \uparrow ) of these two metrics indicate better reconstruction quality of the novel view.
LPIPS measures the perceptual similarity between the rendered and reference images in a deep feature space.
A lower value ( ↓ \downarrow ) indicates better perceptual quality.
In implementation, LPIPS is computed using the AlexNet ( Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ) backbone following the official code ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
Furthermore, to evaluate computational efficiency and representation complexity, we additionally report GPU memory consumption (VRAM), training time (Training), and the final number of Gaussian primitives (#Gs).

blocks.en: 4.2 Results in Smoke Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.2 吸烟场景的结果

blocks.en:
Quantitative Results: For smoke scenes, we evaluate all methods on eight scenes from the RealX3D ( Liu et al., 2026b ) benchmark.
We compare our method with three categories of baselines:
(1) classic 3D reconstruction methods, including 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) , SeaSplat ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , WaterSplatting ( Li et al., 2025a ) , I2-NeRF ( Liu et al., 2026c ) , and SeaThruNeRF ( Levy et al., 2023 ) ;
(2) restoration-based reconstruction pipelines that combine ConvIR-B ( Cui et al., 2024a ) or MB-TF-B V2 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) with 3DGS or WaterSplatting;
and (3) the top-three solutions from the NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction Challenge, including GenSmoke-GS ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , Smoke-GS ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and Dehaze-then-Splat ( Chen and Wang, 2026a ) .
For a fair comparison, all restoration-based reconstruction pipelines are trained under the same supervision setting as MLLM-GS.
ConvIR-B ( Cui et al., 2024a ) and MB-TF-B V2 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) are fine-tuned using the same three paired degraded and clean views per scene, and their restored images are subsequently used to train 3DGS or WaterSplatting.
As shown in Table 1 , classic 3D reconstruction methods generally achieve lower reconstruction quality under severe smoke degradation, indicating the difficulty of recovering clear scenes directly from degraded observations.
Restoration-based reconstruction pipelines improve reconstruction quality by enhancing the input images before 3D reconstruction, achieving average PSNR values ranging from 15.74 15.74 dB to 17.58 17.58 dB.
However, residual artifacts and color distortions in the enhanced views can propagate into the reconstruction process, limiting the final rendering quality.
Challenge-based methods achieve stronger performance, with average PSNR values ranging from 18.28 18.28 dB to 20.21 20.21 dB.
In contrast, our method achieves the highest average PSNR of 22.27 22.27 dB and the lowest average LPIPS of 0.362 0.362 .
Notably, under identical supervision, MLLM-GS achieves an average PSNR improvement of 4.69 4.69 dB over the strongest restoration-based pipeline.
This indicates that the performance gains arise from the effective integration of pretrained MLLM priors and few-shot correction rather than additional supervision.
These results further demonstrate the effectiveness of MLLM-GS in providing reliable supervision for high-quality NVS.

但是,剩余文物和增强视野中的色彩扭曲可以传播到重建过程中,从而限制了最终渲染的质量。

这表明,由于有效整合了经过事先培训的MLLM前科和几发校正而不是额外的监督,取得了性能的提高。
这些结果进一步表明,MLLM-GS能够有效地为高质量的NVS提供可靠的监督.

blocks.en:
Qualitative Results: Fig. 4 presents qualitative comparisons of NVS results on two smoke scenes.
SeaSplat ( Yang et al., 2025a ) produces renderings with substantial residual haze, low contrast, and blurred scene structures.
Restoration-based reconstruction pipelines combining ConvIR-B ( Cui et al., 2024a ) or MB-TF-B V2 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) with WaterSplatting ( Li et al., 2025a ) improve scene visibility but still exhibit color distortions and loss of fine-grained details.
GenSmoke-GS ( Cao et al., 2026 ) recovers clearer structures, although residual haze and color deviations remain visible in some regions.
In contrast, our method substantially reduces residual haze while preserving scene structures, fine textures, and natural colors.
The rendered results are visually closer to the ground-truth images, particularly in object boundaries and textured regions.
These results demonstrate the effectiveness of MLLM-GS in generating visually faithful novel views under severe smoke degradation.
blocks.zh:
定性 结果:图4对两个烟幕的NVS结果进行了定性比较。
SeaSplatz (Yang等, 2025a.) 产生具有大量残留雾霾,低对比度和模糊的场景结构的渲染.
将ConvIR-B(Cui等,2024年a)或MB-TF-B V2(Jin等,2025年)与WaterSplateting(Li等,2025年a)相结合的以恢复为基础的重建管线提高了场景能见度,但仍显示出色彩扭曲并丢失了精细的细节.
一般事务 (Cao等,2026年)收复了更清晰的结构,虽然残留的雾霾和色彩偏差在一些地区仍然可见.
相比之下,我们的方法在保留场景结构、精细纹理和自然颜色的同时,大大减少了残留的烟雾。
获得的结果在视觉上更接近地面真实图像,特别是在物体边界和纹理区域。
这些结果表明,在烟雾严重退化的情况下,LLM-GS在产生视觉上忠实的新观点方面是有效的。

User Study: To further evaluate perceptual quality, we conduct a user study on the synthesized novel views.
We randomly select ten novel viewpoints and invite 55 55 participants to evaluate the corresponding rendered images.
For each viewpoint, the results from different methods are anonymized and presented in random order.
Participants are asked to select the result with the highest perceived visual quality.
As shown in Fig. 5 (a), our method receives 80.72 80.72 % of the total preferences, substantially outperforming the compared baselines.
This result further supports the advantages of MLLM-GS in synthesizing visually realistic novel views under smoke degradation.

blocks.en: 4.3 Results in Low-Light Scenes
blocks.zh: 4.3 低亮场景的结果

blocks.en:
Quantitative Results: We compare our method with nine competing methods, including five classic 3D reconstruction methods (3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) , LITA-GS ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , I2-NeRF ( Liu et al., 2026c ) , Aleth-NeRF ( Cui et al., 2024b ) , and Luminance-GS ( Cui et al., 2025 ) ), and four restoration-based reconstruction pipelines combining DarkIR-m ( Feijoo et al., 2025 ) or Multinex ( Brateanu et al., 2026 ) with 3DGS or LITA-GS.
Similar to the smoke scenario, DarkIR-m ( Feijoo et al., 2025 ) and Multinex ( Brateanu et al., 2026 ) are fine-tuned using the same three paired degraded and clean views per scene.
As shown in Table 2 , classic 3D reconstruction methods generally achieve limited performance under severe low-light conditions, where insufficient illumination and image noise make accurate geometry and appearance estimation challenging.
blocks.zh:
量化结果: 我们的方法与相竞的九种方法比较,包括五种经典的三维重建方法(3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年),LITA-GS(周等,2025年),I2-NERF(刘等,2026年c),Aleth-NERF(Cui等,2024年b),和Luminance-GS(Cui等,2025年),以及将DarkIR-m(Feijoo等,2025年)或Multinex(Brateanu等,2026年)与3DGS或LITA-GS结合的四条基于恢复的重建管道.
与烟雾场景相类似,DarkIR-m(Feijoo等,2025年)和Multnex(Brateanu等,2026年)采用相同的三对已退化和清洁的每个场景来进行微调.
如表2所示,经典的立体重建方法一般在严重的低光条件下实现有限的性能,光照和图像噪音不足使得准确的几何和外观估计具有挑战性.

blocks.en:
Qualitative Results: Fig. 6 illustrates qualitative comparisons of NVS results in representative low-light scenes.
Standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) produces severely underexposed renderings with limited visible structures and textures.
LITA-GS ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) improves overall brightness but still exhibits noticeable noise and color distortions, particularly around object boundaries and textured regions.
Restoration-based reconstruction pipelines combining DarkIR-m ( Feijoo et al., 2025 ) or Multinex ( Brateanu et al., 2026 ) with 3DGS further improve scene visibility, although uneven illumination, color inconsistencies, and loss of fine-grained details remain visible in some regions.
In contrast, our method produces visually faithful renderings with clearer object structures, more consistent colors, and better-preserved local details.
The reconstructed results more closely resemble the ground-truth images in the examples shown, particularly around object boundaries and textured regions.
These observations demonstrate the effectiveness of MLLM-GS in recovering scene appearance and preserving visual details under severe low-light degradation.

blocks.en: 4.4 Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 效率分析

blocks.en:
In this section, we evaluate the reconstruction efficiency of MLLM-GS and competing methods on smoke and low-light scenes in terms of training time, Gaussian count, and GPU memory consumption.
As shown in Table 3 , MLLM-GS achieves high training efficiency under both degradation conditions.
On the smoke scene, MLLM-GS completes 30 30 K training iterations in 10 10 m 06 06 s, achieving a 1.46 × 1.46\times speedup over 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) and a 9.0 × 9.0\times speedup over SeaThruNeRF ( Levy et al., 2023 ) .
On the low-light scene, it requires 9 9 m 38 38 s, achieving a 1.62 × 1.62\times speedup over 3DGS and a 24.4 × 24.4\times speedup over LITA-GS ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
Although Faster-GS ( Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) achieves slightly shorter training times, MLLM-GS provides substantially better reconstruction quality while maintaining comparable optimization efficiency.
Moreover, compared with standard 3DGS, MLLM-GS reduces the Gaussian count by approximately 80 80 % and 95 95 % on the smoke and low-light scenes, respectively.
It also achieves the lowest GPU memory consumption among all compared methods, requiring only 1.98 1.98 GiB and 2.40 2.40 GiB on the two scenes, respectively.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们评价MLLM-GS的重建效率以及从训练时间,高斯计数,和GPU内存消耗等角度对烟雾和低光场景的相竞方法.
如表3所显示的,劳动、劳工、劳工和社会福利部在两种退化条件下都实现了高培训效率。
在烟幕上,MLLM-GS在10 m 06 06 s完成30 K的训练迭接,在3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)上达到1.46×1.46\时速,在SeaThruNeRF(Levy等,2023年)上达到9.0×9.0\时速.
低光场需要9相9相38相38相,实现1.62×1.62相快于3DGS,并实现24.4×24.4相快于LITA-GS(周等,2025年).
虽然更快速的GS(Hahlbohm等,2026年)实现了稍短的训练时间,但MLLM-GS在保持可比较优化效率的同时,提供了大幅提高的重建质量.
此外,与标准3DGS相比,MLLM-GS在烟雾和低光度场景上分别将高斯人计分减少约80个80%和95个95%.
它也实现了所有比较方法中最低的GPU内存消耗,在两个场景上分别只需要1.98 1.98 GiB和2.40 2.40 GiB.

blocks.zh: 图7:烟雾场景(Akikaze)和低光场景(BlueHawaii)的效率分析.

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 further compares the convergence behavior and computational efficiency of different methods.
After only 5 5 K training iterations, MLLM-GS achieves approximately 27 27 dB PSNR on Akikaze and 24 24 dB on BlueHawaii, requiring around 100 100 s.
These results surpass those achieved by all compared methods after 30 30 K iterations, demonstrating that MLLM-GS achieves higher reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations.
In contrast, Faster-GS ( Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) achieves only approximately 11 11 dB and 7 7 dB PSNR on the two scenes, respectively, even after 30 30 K iterations.
This indicates that accelerating Gaussian optimization alone cannot effectively address the reconstruction challenges caused by severe image degradations.
By combining MLLM prior-guided view enhancement with efficient Gaussian optimization, MLLM-GS achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction quality and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh:
图7进一步比较了不同方法的趋同行为和计算效率.
MLLM-GS在经过了5个5K的训练迭接后,在Akikaze上取得了约27个dB 27 dSNR和在BlueHawaii上取得了24个dB,需要约100 s.
这些结果超过了30 K 重迭后所有方法所达到的结果,表明MLLM-GS的重建质量较高,重迭少得多。
相形之下,"快活"-GS(Hahlbohm等,2026年)在两个场景上分别仅能分别实现约11个11分贝和7个7分贝的PSNR,即使经过了30克的迭代.
这表明,仅仅加快高斯优化无法有效应对严重图像退化造成的重建挑战。
通过将MLLM前导视图增强与高效高斯优化相结合,MLLM-GS在重建质量和计算效率之间实现了有利的平衡.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of MLLM Prior: To evaluate the effectiveness of MLLM prior-guided view enhancement, we compare our framework with standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) and two-stage restoration-based reconstruction methods.
Standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) directly optimizes the scene representation from degraded observations without image enhancement.
As shown in Tables 1 and 2 , its average PSNR is below 12 12 dB on both smoke and low-light scenes, indicating its limited ability to reconstruct clean views from severely degraded images.
In contrast, MLLM-GS improves the average PSNR by more than 10 10 dB on both scene types and achieves substantial improvements in SSIM and LPIPS.
Furthermore, although two-stage methods improve reconstruction quality by restoring degraded images before 3D reconstruction, their performance remains inferior to that of MLLM-GS.
This is mainly because degradation-specific restoration models may struggle to recover reliable structural and appearance information under complex imaging conditions.
In contrast, our framework leverages the general visual priors of a pretrained MLLM to enhance degraded observations across different degradation types.
The correction network further reduces residual spatial misalignment and color deviations, providing more reliable pseudo-GT supervision for subsequent 3D reconstruction.
These results demonstrate the effectiveness of MLLM prior-guided view enhancement in improving NVS quality under severe degradations.
blocks.zh:
MLLM 的效力 上 : 为了评估MLLM前导视图增强的效果,我们把我们的框架与标准3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)和两阶段恢复重建方法进行比较.
标准3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)直接优化了从退化观测得到的场景表现而无需增强图像.
如表1和表2所示,其平均PSNR在烟雾和低光场景上都低于12分贝,表明其从严重退化的图像中重建清洁视图的能力有限.
相形之下,MLLM-GS在两种场景类型上将平均PSNR改进了10多分贝,并实现了SSIM和LPIPS的重大改进.
此外,虽然两阶段方法通过在3D重建前恢复已退化的图像来提高重建质量,但其性能仍然低于MLLM-GS。
这主要是因为针对降解的恢复模型可能难以在复杂的成像条件下恢复可靠的结构和外观信息.
相比之下,我们的框架利用预先训练的MLLM的一般视觉前兆,加强不同类型退化的观测。
校正网络还进一步减少了剩余空间错位和色彩偏差,为后三维重建提供了更可靠的伪GT监督.
这些结果表明,在严重退化的情况下,提高MLLM前导视图在提高NVS质量方面的效力。

Compatibility of MLLM Priors: This section evaluates the compatibility of our framework with different MLLM priors.
Specifically, we replace the default Nano Banana Pro ( Raisinghani, 2025 ) with five alternative models, including Wan2.7-Image ( Aliyun, 2026 ) , Qwen-Image-3.0 ( Team, 2026 ) , Seedream-5.0-Lite ( Seed, 2026 ) , GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , and Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and evaluate their performance on the Akikaze smoke scene.
As shown in Table 4 , all five alternatives can be integrated into our framework, achieving PSNR values ranging from 18.09 18.09 dB to 22.29 22.29 dB.
However, their reconstruction performance varies, indicating that the quality of the underlying generative prior influences the final NVS results.
The default model achieves the best performance across all three metrics, with a PSNR of 27.44 27.44 dB, an SSIM of 0.761 0.761 , and an LPIPS of 0.234 0.234 .
These results demonstrate that our framework can accommodate different generative priors, while stronger priors can further improve reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:
MLLM 的兼容性 : 本节评价我们的框架与不同的MLLM前身的相容性.
具体来说,我们将默认的"Nano Banana Pro"(Sheadinghani,2025年)替换为5个替代型号,包括"Wan2.7-Image"(Aliyun,2026年),"Quen-Image-3.0"(Team,2026年),"Seedream-5.0-Lite". (原始内容存档于2026年). GPT-Image-2 (OpenAI, 2026年). Quen-Image-Edit (Wu等, 2025年),并评价其在Akikaze烟雾场的表现.
如表4所示,所有5种替代品都可以纳入我们的框架中,达到18.09 18.09分贝到22.29分贝的多指标种营养素值。
然而,它们的重建表现各有不同,表明先天遗传学的质量影响到最终的NVS结果.
默认模型在所有三个度量衡中都实现了最佳性能,PSNR为27.44 27.44 dB,SSIM为0.761 0.761 ;LPIPS为0.234 0.234.
这些结果表明,我们的框架可以容纳不同的遗传学前科,而更强的遗传学前科可以进一步提高重建质量。

blocks.en:
Necessity of the Correction: To evaluate the necessity of the correction network, we compare the full framework with a variant that directly uses MLLM-enhanced images for 3D reconstruction without correction.
Fig. 8 presents the quantitative results on the Akikaze (smoke) and BlueHawaii (low-light) scenes.
Introducing the correction network consistently improves all three metrics under both degradation conditions.
On the Akikaze scene, PSNR increases from 16.98 16.98 to 27.44 27.44 dB, SSIM improves from 0.601 0.601 to 0.761 0.761 , and LPIPS decreases from 0.524 0.524 to 0.234 0.234 .
The improvements are more pronounced on the BlueHawaii scene, where PSNR increases from 10.50 10.50 to 24.33 24.33 dB, SSIM improves from 0.370 0.370 to 0.776 0.776 , and LPIPS decreases from 0.523 0.523 to 0.379 0.379 .
These improvements indicate that MLLM-enhanced images still contain residual spatial misalignment and color deviations that can affect subsequent 3D reconstruction.
By reducing these errors, the correction network provides more accurate and consistent pseudo-GT supervision, leading to improved reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:
更正的必要性: 为了评价校正网络的必要性,我们将整个框架与一个变体进行比较,该变体直接使用MLLM增强的图像进行3D重建而无需校正.
图8介绍了Akikaze(烟雾)和BlueHawaii(低光)场景的量化结果。
在两种降解条件下,采用矫正网络始终能改善所有三个度量。
在Akikaze场景上,PSNR由16.98 16.98升至27.44 27.44 dB,SSIM由0.601 0.601升至0.761 0.761;LPIPS由0.524 0.524降至0.234 0.234.
BlueHawaii场景的改善更为明显,PSNR从10.50 10.50增加到24.33 24.33 dB,SSIM从0.370 0.370提高到0.776 0.776,LPIPS从0.523 0.523下降到0.379 0.379.
这些改进表明,MLLM-增强的图像仍然包含剩余空间错位和色彩偏差,会影响后三维重建.
通过减少这些出错,校正网络提供了更准确更一致的伪GT监督,导致重建质量得到提高.

blocks.en:
Impact of the GT Views Number: This section investigates the impact of the number of paired clean GT views on reconstruction quality under smoke and low-light conditions.
As shown in Fig. 9 , introducing a small number of GT views substantially improves reconstruction performance, with the largest gains occurring between zero and three views.
Specifically, increasing the number of GT views from zero to three improves PSNR by more than 13 13 dB on the low-light scene and approximately 10 10 dB on the smoke scene.
Similar improvements are observed in SSIM and LPIPS.
As more GT views are introduced, PSNR and SSIM continue to improve, but the gains become smaller.
For example, the additional PSNR improvement beyond five GT views is less than 0.6 0.6 dB on the low-light scene.
Meanwhile, LPIPS achieves its best performance with approximately four to five GT views and does not consistently improve as more views are added.
These results indicate that a few paired clean views already provide effective supervision for the correction network.
Increasing the number of GT views yields diminishing improvements in PSNR and SSIM, while perceptual quality does not necessarily benefit from additional supervision.
blocks.zh:
GT的影响 视图编号 : 本节调查了在烟雾和低光条件下对重建质量的成对GT视图数量的影响.
如图9所示,采用少数GT观点大大改善了重建业绩,最大的收益出现在0到3个观点之间。
具体地说,将GT的取景从零增加为3个改进了PSNR,在低光场增加了13个多分贝,在烟台场增加了约10个多分贝.
在SSIM和LPIPS中也观察到类似的改进.
随着更多的GT观点被引入,PSNR和SSIM继续得到改进,但收益越来越小.
例如,除了5个GT视图外,额外的PSNR改进在低光度场景上还不到0.6分贝.
同时,LPIPS以大约4到5个GT观点达到最佳表现,并且没有随着更多观点的增加而持续改善.
这些结果表明,少数对齐的清洁观点已经为矫正网络提供了有效的监督。
增加GT的取景量会减少PSNR和SSIM的改进,而知觉质量不一定能从额外的监管中受益.

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Rasterization Optimization: To evaluate the effectiveness of rasterization optimization, we replace the standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) rasterization pipeline while keeping all other settings unchanged.
As shown in Table 5 , the number of Gaussians decreases from 2.26 2.26 M to 0.49 0.49 M, GPU memory consumption drops from 8.15 8.15 GiB to 2.57 2.57 GiB, and training time is reduced by 22.3 22.3 %.
The opacity-aware rectangular bounding boxes reduce unnecessary Gaussian–tile intersections by excluding regions with negligible contributions, thereby lowering sorting and forward rasterization costs.
Meanwhile, the bucket-based backward propagation strategy reconstructs the blending process using precomputed boundary states, reducing redundant gradient computations and memory accesses.
In this way, these designs improve rasterization efficiency and reduce the computational overhead of 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
牧场化的效果 优化 : 为了评价光栅化优化的效果,我们更换了标准的3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)光栅化管,同时保持了所有其他设置不变.
如表5所示,高斯人的数量从2.26 2.26米降至0.49 049米,GPU内存消耗从8.15 8.15吉B降至2.57 2.57吉B,培训时间减少22.3% 22.3%.
不透明的长方形边框通过排除贡献微不足道的地区来减少不必要的高斯-瓦地相交,从而降低分拣和前向光栅化成本。
同时,以桶为基础的后向传播战略利用预先计算的边界状态重建了混合过程,减少了冗余梯度计算和内存访问.
这样,这些设计提高了光栅化效率并减少了3D重建的计算间接费用.

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Memory Layout Optimization: To evaluate the effectiveness of memory layout optimization, we introduce Morton-based Gaussian reordering on top of the rasterization optimization.
As shown in Table 5 , the number of Gaussians, memory footprint, and training time are all reduced, with reductions ranging from 4 4 % to 18 18 %.
These improvements demonstrate the benefits of optimizing Gaussian memory organization.
During adaptive densification, newly generated Gaussians are appended to parameter buffers, causing spatially neighboring Gaussians to become scattered across memory.
Morton reordering organizes Gaussians according to their spatial positions, improving memory-access locality and reducing redundant memory accesses during optimization.
By periodically reorganizing Gaussian parameters, this strategy further improves efficiency with limited reordering overhead.
blocks.zh:
内存布局优化的效果 : 为了评价内存布局优化的效果,我们在光栅化优化上引入了以莫顿为主的高斯安重排.
如表5所示,高斯人的人数、记忆足迹和培训时间都减少了,从4%到18%不等。
这些改进显示了优化高斯记忆组织的好处.
适应性增殖过程中,新产生的 高斯人被附加到参数缓冲中,导致空间相邻的高斯人被分散于记忆中.
Morton 重排组织 高斯人根据其空间位置,改善内存访问地点,并减少优化期间的冗余内存访问.
通过定期重组高斯参数,这项战略通过有限的重排间接费用进一步提高了效率。

blocks.en:
Effectiveness of Parameter Update Optimization: We further evaluate the effectiveness of parameter update optimization on top of the rasterization and memory layout optimizations.
As shown in Table 5 , training time decreases from 10 ​ m ​ 42 10m42 s to 10 ​ m ​ 06 10m06 s, while GPU memory consumption is reduced from 2.12 2.12 GiB to 1.98 1.98 GiB.
The number of Gaussians also decreases slightly from 0.47 0.47 M to 0.46 0.46 M.
The training efficiency improvement is mainly attributed to the fused parameter update strategy, which combines the updates of different Gaussian parameter groups into a single CUDA kernel.
This reduces kernel-launch overhead and redundant global-memory accesses while preserving the underlying Adam update rules.
Overall, combining rasterization, memory layout, and parameter update optimizations reduces the number of Gaussians by approximately 80 80 %, GPU memory consumption by 76 76 %, and training time by 31 31 % compared with standard 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) , demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed fast reconstruction branch.
blocks.zh:
参数更新优化的有效性: 我们进一步评价在光栅化和内存优化布局之上的参数更新优化的有效性.
如表5所示,培训时间从10m 42 10m42 s减少到10m 06 10m06 s,而GPU内存消耗从2.12 2.12 GiB减少到1.98 1.98 GiB.
高斯人的数量也从0.47 0.47米略降至0.46 046米.
训练效率的提高主要归功于被引信参数更新策略,该战略将不同高斯参数组的更新合并为一个CUDA内核.
这减少了内核发射机头和冗余的全球元相接器,同时保留了基本的亚当更新规则.
总体而言,结合光栅化,内存布局,和参数更新优化,将高斯人的数量减少了约80 80%,GPU内存消耗了76 76%,与标准3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)相比,训练时间减少了31 31%,证明了拟议快速重建分支的有效性.

Effectiveness of fast 3D scene reconstruction branch: To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed fast 3D reconstruction branch, we compare MLLM-GS with a variant that replaces this branch with Faster-GS ( Hahlbohm et al., 2026 ) while keeping the view enhancement branch unchanged.

As shown in Table 6 , MLLM-GS consistently outperforms the Faster-GS variant across all three metrics in both scenes.
These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed fast reconstruction branch in supporting high-quality 3D scene reconstruction under challenging environmental conditions.

快速 三维场景重建分支的有效性 : 为了评价拟议的快取3D重建分支的有效性,我们将MLLM-GS与一个变体进行比较,该变体将这个分支取而代之为"快取"-GS(Hahlbohm等,2026年),同时保持取景增强分支不变.
在Akikaze (Smoke)和BlueHawaii (Low-Light)的场景上进行实验.
如表6所示,在两个场景中,MLLM-GS的性能始终高于所有三个度量的S更快-GS变体。
这些结果表明,拟议的快速重建处有效地支持了在充满挑战的环境条件下的高质量三维现场重建。

blocks.en: 4.6 Experimental Results for More Degradation Scenarios
blocks.zh: 4.6 更多退化情景的实验结果

blocks.en:
To further evaluate the generalization capability of MLLM-GS across diverse degradation conditions, we conduct additional experiments under strong defocus blur, strong motion blur, and varying exposure.
These scenarios introduce different types of structural and appearance distortions, providing a more comprehensive evaluation of the proposed framework.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步评估不同降解条件下的MLLM-GS的通化能力,我们在强烈去焦模糊、强运动模糊和不同暴露下进行了更多的实验。
这些设想方案引入了不同类型的结构和外观扭曲,为拟议框架提供了更全面的评价。

blocks.en:
Results of Strong Defocus Blur: As shown in Fig. 10 , 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) produces severely degraded renderings with noticeable color shifts, banding artifacts, and blurred scene structures.
BAD-Gaussians ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , BAGS ( Peng et al., 2024 ) , and CoCoGaussian ( Lee et al., 2025 ) recover the overall scene structure, but their results still exhibit blurred object boundaries and missing fine details.
For example, adjacent patches on the color chart become difficult to distinguish, while the fine textures of the toy are largely lost.
In contrast, our method produces clearer scene structures and better-preserved textures. The color chart retains well-defined boundaries, and the toy exhibits more recognizable fur textures and facial details.
These results demonstrate that MLLM-GS can effectively reconstruct scene structures and fine details from observations affected by strong defocus blur.
blocks.zh:
如图10、3DGS(Kerbl等,2023年)所示,强分焦模糊度的结果产生严重退化的渲染物,其颜色变化明显,文物带宽,场景结构模糊。
BAD-高斯人(赵等,2024年-),BAGS(彭等,2024年-),又作可克高斯人. (Lee等,2025)恢复了整体场景结构,但其结果仍然显示出模糊的物体界限和缺失的细微细节.
例如相邻的相邻的相色图上的补丁变得难以区分,而玩具的精细纹理则基本丢失.
相比之下,我们的方法产生了更清晰的场景结构以及保存较好的纹理. 颜色图保留了定义明确的界限,玩具展出更能辨认出毛发纹理和面部细节.
这些结果表明,MLLM-GS能够有效地重建场景结构,并从受到强烈去聚焦模糊影响的观测中得出细微细节.

blocks.en:
Results of Strong Motion Blur: Fig. 11 presents qualitative comparisons of NVS results under strong motion blur.
3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) produces severe motion-related artifacts, resulting in distorted scene structures and blurred object boundaries.
BAD-Gaussians ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) and CoCoGaussian ( Lee et al., 2025 ) recover the overall scene layout, but their results still suffer from blurred textures and missing fine details.
BAGS ( Peng et al., 2024 ) also recovers the scene structure but introduces noticeable stripe artifacts.
In contrast, our method generates clearer novel views with more accurate object boundaries and better-preserved textures.
In particular, the color chart retains distinguishable patches, while the fur textures of the toy and the structures of small objects remain clearly recognizable.
These results demonstrate the effectiveness of MLLM-GS in preserving scene structures and fine details under strong motion blur.
blocks.zh:
强运动模糊度的结果:图11在强运动模糊度下给出了NVS结果的质量比较.
3DGS (Kerbl等, 2023年)出产了与运动相关的严重文物,导致场景结构被扭曲并模糊了物体边界.
BAD-Gausians (赵等,2024年)和CoCoGausian (Lee等,2025年)恢复了整体场景布局,但其结果仍然有模糊的纹理和缺失的细微细节.
BAGS(Peng等,2024年)也恢复了场景结构,但引入了明显的条纹文物.
相形之下,我们的方法产生出更清晰的新颖观点,具有更准确的物体边界和保存较好的纹理.
特别是颜色图保留了可分辨的补丁,而玩具的毛发纹理和小物体的结构仍然清晰可辨.
这些结果显示MLLM-GS在强烈运动模糊下有效保存了场景结构和精细细节.

blocks.en:
Results of Varying Exposure: Fig. 12 presents qualitative comparisons of NVS results under varying exposure conditions.
3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) is sensitive to exposure variations, producing severely underexposed renderings with substantial detail loss.
LITA-GS ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) improves the overall brightness, but noticeable color and contrast deviations remain in some regions.
DarkIR-m ( Feijoo et al., 2025 ) + 3DGS and Multinex ( Brateanu et al., 2026 ) + 3DGS further improve scene visibility, but their results still exhibit blurred textures and local color distortions.
In contrast, our method produces novel views with more natural brightness, improved color fidelity, and clearer scene details.
In particular, the structures and textures of objects such as the teddy bear, bicycle, and indoor furniture are better preserved.
These results demonstrate that MLLM-GS can effectively handle exposure variations and generate high-quality novel views with more faithful scene appearance.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper proposes MLLM-GS, an MLLM prior-guided framework for fast novel view synthesis in extreme environments.
It consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction.
The former combines a frozen MLLM with a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel misalignment and color distortions, providing reliable pseudo-GT supervision using only a few paired clean views.
The latter accelerates 3DGS optimization from three aspects: rasterization, memory layout, and parameter updates.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLLM-GS achieves high-quality novel view synthesis across diverse severe degradations while substantially reducing reconstruction time and GPU memory consumption.
blocks.zh:
本文提出MLLM-GS,是MLLM在极端环境中快速新颖视图合成的前导框架.
它由两个分支组成:MLLM前导取景增强和快取3D场景重建.
前者将被冷冻的MLLM与轻量级的校正网络相融合,以减少像素错配和色彩扭曲,仅使用几对干净的视图提供可靠的伪GT监督.
后者从三个方面加速了3DGS优化:光栅化,内存布局,和参数更新.
广泛的实验表明,MLLM-GS在各种严重退化中实现了高质量的新视角合成,同时大大减少了重建时间和GPU内存消耗.
